rows.notes: The study is a narrative literature review (Section 2 'Material and method' describes a database search of Scopus, Springer Link, Science Direct, NAL and Google Scholar; abstract and Section 9 call it a review). It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs. Its statements on UAV-based remote sensing (Section 5.1, Table 1) are summaries of other work and generic lists of advantages/disadvantages, not results of its own on drones delivering crop productivity or yield gains. Q1 is 'no', so Q2-Q9 are 'no'.

notes: Full text appears complete (abstract through references). The paper is explicitly a review with a described literature-search methodology and 'threats to validity' section typical of reviews; no primary empirical content on remote sensing or crop production.
